name: text-spacing-trim
desc: Specify how spacing around CJK punctuation is trimmed according to its position and neighboring characters. The normal and auto values do not change punctuation spacing. The space-all and space-first values are not supported.

values.desc: Trim opening punctuation spacing at every line start, with normal spacing elsewhere.
Trim opening and closing punctuation spacing at line edges and collapse spacing between adjacent punctuation.
Trim full-width opening, closing, and middle-dot punctuation spacing regardless of position or neighboring characters.

formal_syntax: normal | space-all | space-first | trim-start | trim-both | trim-all | auto

note.literal: The property maps to punctuation compression options in the Textra paragraph style. Platform text layout does not support it.
